about.title: About AidNet
about.missionBody: AidNet connects generous people with verified organizations running campaigns for causes that matter. We make giving transparent, so you always know who you are helping and how.
about.howOrgs: Organizations request to join and are reviewed by administrators before approval.
about.howCampaigns: Approved organizations create and manage their own donation campaigns.
about.howDonors: Donors browse live campaigns and contribute through the donation method of their choice.
about.howRoles: Role-based access ensures the right people manage the right things.
about.trustBody: Every organization is reviewed before it can launch a campaign, and every campaign states its goal, description, and donation methods up front.
about.contactPrompt: Questions? We would love to hear from you.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy matters. This policy explains, in plain language, what data AidNet collects and how it is used.
privacy.collectBody: Account information you provide at sign-up (email address and name), organization profiles and campaign content you create, records of donations made through the platform, and your language preference (stored only in your own browser).
privacy.useBody: To operate the platform, display campaigns, keep records of donations, and send you essential account emails such as password resets. That is all.
privacy.noSellTitle: We Do Not Sell Your Data
privacy.noSellBody: We do not sell, rent, or share your personal data with third parties, and the platform runs no ads or third-party trackers.
privacy.securityBody: Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and access is restricted by role-based authorization enforced at the database level — not just in the interface.
privacy.rightsBody: You can request an export or deletion of your personal data at any time through the contact page, and we aim to respond as soon as we can.
privacy.childrenBody: AidNet is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect their data.
privacy.changesBody: If this policy changes, the updated version will be posted on this page with a new date.
privacy.contactBody: For any privacy question or request, reach us through the contact page.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of AidNet. By using the platform you agree to them.
terms.acceptanceBody: By creating an account or using AidNet in any way, you accept these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the platform.
terms.accountsBody: Provide accurate information when signing up and keep your credentials secure. You are responsible for activity that happens under your account.
terms.organizationsBody: Organizations must submit truthful information during review, run lawful fundraising, and keep their campaigns accurate and up to date. Funds raised belong to the organization, which is solely responsible for their use.
terms.donationsBody: AidNet is a platform that connects donors with organizations — it is not a charity and does not hold or distribute funds itself. Donations are made to the organization running the campaign. Please review a campaign carefully before giving.
terms.useBody: Do not misuse the platform: no fraud, misrepresentation, unlawful content, or attempts to break the service or other users' accounts.
terms.availabilityBody: The platform is provided "as is". While we work hard to keep it reliable and secure, we cannot guarantee uninterrupted availability and limit our liability to the extent permitted by law.
terms.changesBody: We may update these terms as the platform evolves. Continued use after a change means you accept the updated terms.
terms.contactBody: Reach us any time through the contact page.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: Questions, feedback, privacy requests, or a problem with a campaign — we want to hear it.
contact.emailNote: We aim to respond within a few business days. Including your account email and the page you were on helps us help you faster.
